visual_action: A clip from a talk show-style event. Actress Meryl Streep appears on a large video screen in front of a live audience and addresses Kamala Harris. The video then cuts to Harris on stage, sitting next to Oprah Winfrey, reacting with a laugh. The audience applauds enthusiastically as the video cuts back to the wider shot.

cast.name: Meryl Streep
cast.evidence: On-screen text reads 'Meryl Streep sees the vision'. She is shown on a video screen saying 'Hello, President Harris'.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: She is identified by face-ID and is addressed directly in the audio as 'President Harris'.

spoken_summary: Actress Meryl Streep greets Vice President Kamala Harris by saying, "Hello, President Harris." Harris laughs and replies, "Not yet!", which is followed by laughter and loud applause from the live audience.
audio_music: The audio consists of dialogue and the natural sound of a large, live audience laughing and applauding enthusiastically. There is no background music.
editing_pacing: The editing uses simple cuts between a wide shot of the event, showing Meryl Streep on screen and the audience, and a medium shot of Kamala Harris reacting on stage.
central_claim: Meryl Streep publicly supports the idea of Kamala Harris becoming president in the future.
intended_effect: To create positive association and excitement for a potential future presidency for Kamala Harris by highlighting a celebrity endorsement.
